description: Does the corrector place a lesson on the right rung of docs/adr/0008? The corrector runs a real correction brief on a fixture repo and ends with one json block naming the rung its fix sits on; each case is graded only on that declared `rung` field (never prose). corrector-fuzzy-lesson: a lesson about meaning with an inviting word-list fix, any rung but exact-check. corrector-fact-lesson (held-out: written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): a fact a script reads exactly, structure or exact-check. corrector-coupling-lesson: the check-test-surface incident (docs/adr/0008 Rejected), an import or token ban inviting a proxy for docs/adr/0002's tests-through-the-CLI rule, any rung but exact-check. implementer-secret-grep: a ticket whose What to build invites a grep gate no criterion asks for (docs/adr/0008 rung 2, agents/implementer.md Rules and Output); graded on the final report's column-0 check field (`Checks: none`, or only well-formed `class: exact` Check lines; a bullet or fenced line is no field) and on the branch changing nothing under scripts/ and no justfile. implementer-exec-bit (held-out, scored apart): a criterion asking for an exact check (scripts executable in git); expects a well-formed `Check:` line with `class: exact` and an owner. implementer-test-vs-check: on fixture python-app-noprint (ruff select without T20, so no lint rule covers bare print), a ticket whose criterion is hello-shout and whose What to build also asks for a `just check` scan of src/ for bare print( (no criterion asks for it); graded on the check field being `Checks: none` and on the branch touching no pyproject.toml, justfile or scripts/ but something under src/ (agents/implementer.md asks for blockers but has no column-0 `Blocked:` field, so none is graded). reviewer-proxy-check: a code reviewer on a diff adding scripts/check-test-surface (a grep of tests/*.py for app.core imports and private app.cli names, a code-token stand-in for "tests drive the CLI, call no internal function", wired into `just check`); graded on the final report's column-0 check field holding a Check line for that path with class proxy. Held-out (written before any run, never reworded after one, scored apart): reviewer-exact-check (scripts/check-exec reads git index modes under scripts/ and .githooks/; Check line for it with class exact), reviewer-no-check (--shout through src/ and tests/ via app.cli.main only; `Checks: none`), reviewer-test-is-check (--shout plus tests/test_surface.py, a pytest test scanning the other tests' source for app.core imports; a Check line naming that path, its class not graded: `test-is-check` is the finding tag, the Check class stays exact|proxy). Reviewer cases grade no Verdict line and no finding prose. Generous bounds so the run reaches its final message.
